error.not_found.note: Error of the server: the address or the object does not exist, or the visitor may not read it. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.not_logged_in.note: Error of the server: the request needs a session. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.forbidden.text: Your role in the team does not allow this.
error.forbidden.note: Error of the server: a member of a team lacks the role for the action. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.internal.text: An error in the server. Please try again later.
error.internal.note: Error of the server: an error that no handler took. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.method_not_allowed.text: This method is not allowed here.
error.method_not_allowed.note: Error of the server: the HTTP method is not allowed for the address. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.body_too_large.note: Error of the server: the body of the request is above the limit. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_request.note: Error of the server: the body of the request does not have the expected fields. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.csrf.text: The request was refused because its origin is wrong.
error.csrf.note: Error of the server: a write without the right Origin header or X-Requested-With header. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.rate_limited.text: Too many tries. Please wait a little and then try again.
error.rate_limited.note: Error of the server: the rate limit of an action is exceeded. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_email.text: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
error.invalid_email.note: Error of the server: the e-mail address of a registration or an invitation is not valid. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_handle.text: The name needs 3 to 30 characters: small letters a–z, digits and hyphens, not at the start or the end and not two in a row.
error.invalid_handle.note: Error of the server: the handle of an account or a team breaks the rules. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.reserved_handle.text: This name is reserved. Please choose another one.
error.reserved_handle.note: Error of the server: the handle of an account or a team is a reserved word. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.handle_taken.text: This name is already taken. Please choose another one.
error.handle_taken.note: Error of the server: another account or team has the handle, or another owner freed it a short time ago and it is still blocked. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.weak_password.short.text: The password needs at least {min} characters.
error.weak_password.short.note: Error of the server (weak_password, variant short, from password_problem in security.py): the password is too short. {min} is the least number of characters. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.weak_password.long.text: The password can have at most {max} characters.
error.weak_password.long.note: Error of the server (weak_password, variant long, from password_problem in security.py): the password is too long. {max} is the largest number of characters. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.weak_password.guessable.text: This password is too easy to guess. Add another word or two, best uncommon ones.
error.weak_password.guessable.note: Error of the server (weak_password, variant guessable, from password_problem in security.py): the strength check (zxcvbn, app/strength.py) gives the password less than its top score, or it has fewer than 4 different characters. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.weak_password.personal.text: The password must not be your e-mail address or your name.
error.weak_password.personal.note: Error of the server (weak_password, variant personal, from password_problem in security.py): the password is the e-mail address, its local part or the handle. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_token.register.text: The link is invalid or expired. Please register again.
error.invalid_token.register.note: Error of the server (invalid_token, variant register, POST /api/auth/confirm): the link of the confirmation mail is used or expired. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_token.reset.text: The link is invalid or expired. Please ask for a new one.
error.invalid_token.reset.note: Error of the server (invalid_token, variant reset, POST /api/auth/reset): the link of the mail for a new password is used or expired. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_token.invitation.text: The invitation is invalid, expired, withdrawn or already accepted.
error.invalid_token.invitation.note: Error of the server (invalid_token, variant invitation, _open_invitation in teams.py): the link of an invitation mail no longer works. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.wrong_password.confirm.text: The password does not match this registration. Did you forget it, or did somebody else register with your address? Then simply register again.
error.wrong_password.confirm.note: Error of the server (wrong_password, variant confirm, POST /api/auth/confirm): the password does not match the registration of the confirmation link. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.wrong_password.current.note: Error of the server (wrong_password, variant current, check_password in accounts.py): the password of the signed-in account is wrong, when the password changes, the account goes or a team goes. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_credentials.text: The e-mail address or the password is wrong.
error.invalid_credentials.note: Error of the server: the sign-in found no account with this e-mail address and password. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.not_confirmed.text: Please confirm your e-mail address first, with the link in our e-mail.
error.not_confirmed.note: Error of the server: the sign-in of an account that is not confirmed yet. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.last_owner.account.text: You are the only owner of {teams}. First give the role to another member, or delete the team.
error.last_owner.account.note: Error of the server (last_owner, variant account, _delete_sole_teams in accounts.py): the account cannot go while it is the only owner of a team with other members. {teams} is the list of the handles of these teams, joined with a comma and a space. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.last_owner.member.text: A team needs at least one owner. First give the role to another member.
error.last_owner.member.note: Error of the server (last_owner, variant member, last_owner in teams.py): a new role, a removal or leaving would leave the team without an owner. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_title.text: The title needs 1 to {max} characters, without control characters.
error.invalid_title.note: Error of the server: the title of a map breaks the rules. {max} is the largest number of characters. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_slug.text: The address of the map needs 1 to 60 characters: a–z, 0–9 and hyphens, not at the start or the end. Some words are reserved.
error.invalid_slug.note: Error of the server: the slug (the last part of the address) of a map breaks the rules. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.slug_taken.text: A map with this address exists here already.
error.slug_taken.note: Error of the server: the owner has another map with this slug. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

text.one: At most {max} map is possible here.
text.other: At most {max} maps are possible here.

error.too_many_maps.note: Error of the server: the account or the team has the largest number of maps. {max} is that number, and it picks the form. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.not_own_map.text: Only a map of your own can move into a team.
error.not_own_map.note: Error of the server: a map of a team cannot move into a team. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_visibility.text: The visibility is private, link or public.
error.invalid_visibility.note: Error of the server: an unknown visibility. private, link and public are the values of the API: keep them. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_embed.text: Who may embed the map is all (every website) or origins (only the websites of the list).
error.invalid_embed.note: Error of the server: an unknown embed setting. all and origins are the values of the API: keep them. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.too_many_origins.text: The list can have at most {max} websites.
error.too_many_origins.note: Error of the server: the list of the embed setting is too long. {max} is the largest number of websites. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_collection.text: The name of the collection is not valid: a–z at the start, then a–z, 0–9, _ or -, at most 41 characters.
error.invalid_collection.note: Error of the server: the name of a collection of documents breaks the rules. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_id.text: The id of the document is not valid: 1 to 200 characters, without / and without control characters, and not “.”, “..” or “__proto__”.
error.invalid_id.note: Error of the server: the id of a document breaks the rules. “.”, “..” and “__proto__” are ids: keep them. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_id.areas.text: The id of an area is not valid. Allowed are small letters, digits, “-” and “_”, a letter first, at most 40 characters.
error.invalid_id.areas.note: Error of the server (invalid_id, variant areas, check_doc_id in store.py): the id of an area breaks the stricter rule of areas. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_id.stations.text: The id of a station is not valid. Allowed are letters, digits, “-” and “_”, a letter first, at most 40 characters, not “{code}” and no small “i” at the end.
error.invalid_id.stations.note: Error of the server (invalid_id, variant stations, check_doc_id in store.py): the id of a station breaks the stricter rule of stations. {code} is the reserved code PRIVAT. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_id.groups.text: The id of a category is not valid. Allowed are small letters, digits, “-” and “_”, at most 120 characters.
error.invalid_id.groups.note: Error of the server (invalid_id, variant groups, check_doc_id in store.py): the id of a category breaks the stricter rule of categories. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_document.notObject.text: A document is a JSON object.
error.invalid_document.notObject.note: Error of the server (invalid_document, variant notObject, document_size in store.py): a document is no JSON object. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_document.tooDeep.text: The document is nested too deeply.
error.invalid_document.tooDeep.note: Error of the server (invalid_document, variant tooDeep, _check_value in store.py and too_deep in main.py): a document is nested deeper than the limit. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_document.nullCharacter.text: The document holds a null character.
error.invalid_document.nullCharacter.note: Error of the server (invalid_document, variant nullCharacter, _check_value in store.py): a text in a document holds the character U+0000. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_document.notUtf8.text: The document holds a character that UTF-8 cannot hold as text.
error.invalid_document.notUtf8.note: Error of the server (invalid_document, variant notUtf8, _check_value in store.py): a text in a document holds a lone surrogate. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_document.notFinite.text: The document holds NaN or Infinity.
error.invalid_document.notFinite.note: Error of the server (invalid_document, variant notFinite, _check_value in store.py): a number in a document is NaN or Infinity. Keep NaN and Infinity. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.document_too_large.text: A document can have at most {kb} KB.
error.document_too_large.note: Error of the server: a document is above the limit. {kb} is the limit in kilobytes. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.map_too_large.text: A map can have at most {mb} MB.
error.map_too_large.note: Error of the server: a map is above the limit. {mb} is the limit in megabytes. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.conflict.text: Somebody changed this document somewhere else in the meantime. Load the new state, and then change it again.
error.conflict.note: Error of the server: a write of a document that changed after the version that the writer knows. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.conflict.moved.text: This map moved to another owner in the meantime. Load the page again, and then try once more.
error.conflict.moved.note: Error of the server (conflict, variant moved, maps._map_after_owner): a change of a map while another request moved it into a team. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_map_file.notObject.text: This is not a map file.
error.invalid_map_file.notObject.note: Error of the server (invalid_map_file, variant notObject, parse_map_file in store.py): the file is no JSON object. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_map_file.schema.text: The file has no valid schema version.
error.invalid_map_file.schema.note: Error of the server (invalid_map_file, variant schema, parse_map_file in store.py): the schema of the file is no whole number of 1 or more. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_map_file.noCollections.note: Error of the server (invalid_map_file, variant noCollections, parse_map_file in store.py): the file has no object collections. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_map_file.collection.text: The collection {name} is not an object.
error.invalid_map_file.collection.note: Error of the server (invalid_map_file, variant collection, parse_map_file in store.py): a collection of the file is no object. {name} is the name of the collection. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.wrong_format.text: The file does not have the format {format}.
error.wrong_format.note: Error of the server: the file is no map file. {format} is the name of the format, it-skills-map. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.unsupported_schema.text: The file is newer than this server. Please update the server.
error.unsupported_schema.note: Error of the server: the schema of the map file is newer than the server knows. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

text.one: You can lead at most {max} team.
text.other: You can lead at most {max} teams.

error.too_many_teams.note: Error of the server: the account is owner of the largest number of teams. {max} is that number, and it picks the form. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

text.one: This member leads {max} team already, the most that one account can lead.
text.other: This member leads {max} teams already, the most that one account can lead.

error.too_many_teams.member.note: Error of the server (too_many_teams, variant member, change_member in teams.py): an owner of a team gives the role owner to a member, but that member is owner of the largest number of teams already. {max} is that number, and it picks the form. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.already_member.text: You are already a member of this team.
error.already_member.note: Error of the server: an invitation to a team of which the account is a member already. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_name.text: The name of the team needs 1 to 100 characters, without a line break and without hidden characters.
error.invalid_name.note: Error of the server: the name of a team breaks the rules. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_role.text: The role is owner, editor or reader.
error.invalid_role.note: Error of the server: an unknown team role. owner, editor and reader are the values of the API: keep them. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.invalid_origin.text: “{origin}” is not a valid address of a website. An address looks like https://example.org, without a path.
error.invalid_origin.note: Error of the server: a website in the list of the embed setting is not valid. {origin} is the address as typed, at most 80 characters. https://example.org is a reserved example address: keep it. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.

error.bad_language.text: This language is not available. The languages are {languages}.
error.bad_language.note: Error of the server: a registration or a change of the account names a language that the server does not have. {languages} is the list of the language codes of the server, for example en, de. Shows where a page reports an error of the server, for example in the message line of the account page.
